name: Crown of the Earth

angles.text: As a night elf, you carry sacred moonwell water into a meeting that shows the kaldorei’s divided leadership between Tyrande’s priesthood and Fandral’s druids.
As a priest, you serve High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, whose clergy helps guide and govern night elf society.
As a druid, you hear Tyrande’s sharp words about Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm, which show the growing friction within the Cenarion Circle in Malfurion’s absence.
As an ally, you meet the leader of Darnassus and glimpse the political strains within one of the Alliance’s key capitals.

aliases: what is crown of the earth
faq.answer: In Darnassus, you carry Moonwell Remnants in a ceremonial vessel to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind inside the Temple of the Moon. The meeting brings you before the night elves’ supreme leader.
faq.q: What is Crown of the Earth?

faq.answer: Tyrande Whisperwind is the High Priestess of Elune and the night elves’ political leader. From the upper tier of the Temple of the Moon, she oversees Darnassus and bears the burden of guiding her people through troubled times.

aliases: why bring moonwell remnants to tyrande
faq.answer: The Moonwell Remnants are sacred water blessed by Elune. You place them in a ceremonial vessel and bring them to Tyrande, who receives and safeguards them on the goddess’s behalf.
faq.q: Why are the Moonwell Remnants brought to Tyrande?

faq.answer: With Malfurion Stormrage absent, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm leads the druids. Tyrande maintains that governing Darnassus and leading the kaldorei remain her responsibility alone, and will not let druidic authority eclipse Elune’s priesthood.
faq.q: What is the dispute between Tyrande and Fandral Staghelm?

faq.answer: Malfurion Stormrage is absent from Darnassus, leaving a leadership vacuum among the druids. Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm has stepped in to fill it, heightening the political strain with Tyrande.
faq.q: Where is Malfurion during this quest?

aliases: where is temple of the moon
faq.answer: The Temple of the Moon stands in the heart of Darnassus. It is the Sisterhood of Elune’s chief sanctuary, and Tyrande holds audience on the upper level above the main sanctuary floor.
faq.q: Where is the Temple of the Moon?

sections.body: Once the sacred Moonwell Remnants are collected, you pour the blessed water into a ceremonial vessel and carry it to Tyrande Whisperwind. The High Priestess of Elune keeps audience high within the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She watches over the city and offers her goddess’s light to all who enter. To place sacred water in her care is an honor and an act of devotion to Elune.
sections.title: Audience with the High Priestess

sections.body: Tyrande gives deep thanks for saving the blessed water. Then her thoughts turn to the strains gripping Darnassus. With Malfurion Stormrage absent, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm has taken charge of druidic affairs. Yet Tyrande makes clear that governing the kaldorei is her burden alone. She urges respect for Staghelm’s station, but the exchange shows sharp friction between the Sisterhood of Elune and the Cenarion Circle.
sections.title: Tensions in Leadership

summary: Within Darnassus, purified Moonwell Remnants are brought to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. The meeting takes place in the Temple of the Moon, where the waters’ sacred meaning meets the strain between Tyrande and Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm.
attribution: In-game quest text: Crown of the Earth
